# Viking Graveyard

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: ShipSetting01 | Location: Meadows

# Introduction

Viking Graveyards are Points of interest found in the Meadows.

## Description

Viking Graveyards appear as stones shaped like a Viking Longship. Random trees and boulders will spawn within the 'ship' outline, so the Graveyard can be camouflaged somewhat.

## Loot

Digging around these areas will result in the player discovering a Viking Graveyard Chest with a 80% chance, two skeletal remains (which give one Bone fragments upon pickup), and a 50% for a valuable among 1-4 Amber, 2-14 Coins or 1-2 Amber pearl.
The treasures are buried along the central line of the ship, roughly all at the same depth equivalent to three or four pickaxe hits. A Wishbone will lead the player directly to the chest, although the loot is not likely to be worth it for a player at that stage of the game.

## Trivia

• The formation is inspired from real world Stone Ship or Ship Setting which was an early burial custom in Scandinavia.
